Spare blankets, explained for anyone travelling with a pet
They often ask us about it

Spare blankets for pet travel

A spare blanket can help a pet settle more easily during a journey. It gives familiar texture, warmth, and a small sense of routine when the day feels busy. At Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk recommends bringing one that is clean, lightweight, and easy to fold into a carrier.

Use a blanket your pet already knows, if possible. Familiar fabric may reduce restlessness and make the carrier feel less like a new place. Keep the blanket free of loose threads, sharp fasteners, or strong scents, since calm handling is always the best approach for animals in transit.

Please keep your blanket ready with the rest of your travel items so it can be checked quickly at the airport. The ground team handles carriers carefully between services, and a tidy blanket helps them place your pet comfortably without delay. If your journey includes a lounge visit, staff will guide you on where soft items may be used. <<FACT F002>>. <<FACT F024>>. <<FACT F011>>.

If your pet is anxious, tell the supervisor or a member of the desk team before departure. They listen carefully to concerns and can suggest humane, practical steps that support a smoother trip. A spare blanket is a simple item, but it often helps the whole journey feel more settled.

For more help, please contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
